integrity: Analytic proof and finite reproducibility checks are provided. Closely related published norm-computation and extension-reduction results are acknowledged; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the specific equilateral-leaf three-star and real p-Banach targets for 0<p<=1; no statement for arbitrary metrics or complex targets. The classification of centers is specific to the canonical free p-space target.
title: Sharp three-leaf star extension constants for real \(p\)-Banach targets
